description:
In Manager.io (Northwind Traders), create a new 'Holiday Gift Basket' inventory kit. First, you must enable the 'Inventory Kits' module in Settings if it is not already visible. Then, create the kit with the following details:

- Name: Holiday Gift Basket
- Sale Price: 79.99
- Components:
  1. Chai Tea (Quantity: 2)
  2. Extra Virgin Olive Oil (Quantity: 1)
  3. Dark Chocolate Assortment (Quantity: 3)

Login credentials: administrator / (empty password).
